adr: ADR-022 part three, T8 node half (gate A)

checks.check: runsc registered as a docker runtime
checks.detail: `docker info` lists io.containerd.runc.v2 nvidia runc -- no runsc, so sandboxd's Runtime:"runsc" would fail to start rather than silently fall back, but this node cannot host Runs

checks.check: no host path shared writable into a container
checks.detail: read `docker inspect .Mounts` on 5 container(s); a Type=bind mount with RW=true is a writable host path (dockerdrv keeps Binds and Mounts empty on purpose -- C-05/C-07) -- funny_hoover:/c/Users/a8022/OneDrive/Desktop/SkillHub/docs/plans/mvp/m4/sec-009-acceptance/2026-08-27-nested-dev-container-t5/T8-node(rw), skillhub-api:C:\Users\a8022\OneDrive\Desktop\SkillHub(rw)

checks.check: each Run gets its own scratch, Runs share none
checks.detail: NOT MEASURABLE FROM A SNAPSHOT OF ONE NODE. C-01's runtime half is a statement about two concurrent Runs; this probe photographs an idle node. That half is covered by SBX-005's integration tests, not by this script. Reported as unknown rather than omitted, because omitting it would let a green gate A imply C-01 was checked in full

checks.check: declared role is the execution pool
checks.detail: node facts declare role='sandbox-exec' (read from /etc/skillhub/node.json, written by IaC)

checks.check: only sandbox + platform containers run here
checks.detail: read `docker ps`; a container counts as expected only if it carries the skillhub.sandbox.managed label (dockerdrv puts it on every Run) or is sandboxd itself -- 5 of 5 containers are neither: funny_hoover (docker:cli), skillhub-api (golang:1.25), skillhub-postgres-1 (pgvector/pgvector:pg17), skillhub-seaweedfs-1 (chrislusf/seaweedfs:3.80), springaitest-appdb-1 (pgvector/pgvector:pg17@sha256:7ae6051efd0e60444282c27c7e141af07f322ce033300e727a49c3dd11075e38)

checks.check: gVisor at or above the baseline
checks.detail: baseline file says `unset`: the baseline itself has no value, so there is nothing to compare against. ADR-022 §2 makes P-04 blocking -- an unset baseline admits no node, and that is fail-closed, not a probe defect

scanned every readable /proc/<pid>/environ; /etc/skillhub; /etc/environment; /etc/default; /run/secrets; /opt/skillhub for the names SKILLHUB_DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_URL, PGPASSWORD, SKILLHUB_SECRETS_TOKEN and for postgres:// URLs (values deliberately not printed)
